snippet.title: Beneath | Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Descend into the abyss in Beneath, a Lovecraftian first-person survival-horror adventure. Diver Noah Quinn’s expedition spirals into chaos as he battles nightmarish creatures, dwindling supplies, and creeping madness. With his daughter’s life at stake and an ancient evil awakening, Noah must uncover a sinister truth to save humanity—or let the abyss claim them all. 

Beneath is coming to Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5.

#Lovecraftian #HorrorGame #FPS #IndieGame
